edgeAATolerance.reason: Measured on CI 39651515299 (3 identical runs, host bitmap route for dashes): maxInBand 204, over-32 pixels 340 of 12979 band pixels (2.6%), mean 2.54, out-of-band 0. Dash starts agree within 1 px along the top edge (Mac 52,72,97,122,147; Windows 52,73,98,123,148): the residual is the sub-pixel position of the butt dash ends (up to a full pixel of coverage at a dash end) and corner arcs. Tolerance = measured plus about 15%.
